services.name: AgentService
services.description:
AgentService manages an org's agents (ADR 0020). Every request names the
org it acts in; IDs from another org are not found.

methods.name: ActivateAgent
methods.description:
ActivateAgent activates a draft, or moves an active agent to its newer proposed version
(ADR 0066), and so approves the grants that version proposes. Admins and owners only.

methods.name: ArchiveAgent
methods.description:
ArchiveAgent archives a draft or active agent and cancels its unfinished
runs. Admins and owners only.

methods.name: CreateAgentFromTemplate
methods.description:
CreateAgentFromTemplate creates a draft agent from a template. Members
and above.

methods.name: GetAgent
methods.description: GetAgent returns one agent. Viewers and above.

methods.name: GetAgentModel
methods.description:
GetAgentModel says which model the agent's next run uses and where that choice comes from, and
lists the models an admin may pick. Admins and owners only.

methods.name: ListAgents
methods.description: ListAgents returns the org's agents, oldest first. Viewers and above.

methods.name: ResumeAgent
methods.description:
ResumeAgent clears the unhealthy state of an agent whose sandbox got stuck again and again
(ADR 0054), so it takes runs again; its stuck sandbox is recreated. Audited. Admins and owners
only.

methods.name: RunAgentTrigger
methods.description:
RunAgentTrigger fires one schedule trigger of the active version now, as the scheduler would
at a due time, with the trigger's instruction. The task is marked as a manual fire. Audited.
Admins and owners only.

methods.name: SetAgentModel
methods.description:
SetAgentModel sets the agent's model, or clears it with "default". It is a setting of the
agent, not a new version: it applies to the agent's next run. The model must be one the org
serves and has a price for. Audited, with the old and the new value. Admins and owners only.

methods.name: SetAgentThinking
methods.description:
SetAgentThinking sets whether the agent's model thinks: "on" or "off", or clears the setting
with an empty value so the version's value (a template's spec.model.thinking) and then the
default, on, apply. Thinking is on unless somebody turns it off (ADR 0069 amendment
2026-10-29). Like the model it is a setting of the agent, not a new version, and applies to the
next run. A model that cannot think ignores it (GetAgentModel says so). Audited, with the old
and the new value. Admins and owners only.

methods.name: SetAgentTriggers
methods.description:
SetAgentTriggers proposes a new version with the given triggers (everything else carried over
from the latest version). The triggers fire nothing until ActivateAgent activates that
version; an active agent keeps running its active version meanwhile. Audited. Admins and
owners only.

messages.name: ActivateAgentRequest
messages.description: ActivateAgentRequest names the draft and the version the caller reviewed.

fields.name: version
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Must equal the agent's latest_version, so the caller approves exactly the
grants they saw; otherwise the call fails with FailedPrecondition.

fields.name: apply_to_open_tickets
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Start fresh sessions, with a handoff, on the agent's open tickets: their next run begins a new
session from the agent's last notes and replies instead of loading the old one, so the new
version's instructions apply (ADR 0051 amendment). Default off; audited.

messages.name: ActivateAgentResponse
messages.description: ActivateAgentResponse holds the active agent.

fields.name: tickets_restarting
fields.label: singular
fields.description: How many open tickets were marked to start a fresh session.

messages.name: Agent
messages.description: Agent is an agent and the definition it runs.

fields.name: template_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The template content the agent was created from, if any.

fields.name: latest_version
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The newest version. ActivateAgent must name it.

fields.name: active_version
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The approved version runs execute; 0 before the first activation.

fields.name: proposed_grants
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Grants the latest version proposes.

fields.name: approved_grants
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Grants approved with the active version.

fields.name: unhealthy_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Set while the agent is unhealthy: its sandbox got stuck three times in 24 hours and was not
recreated again (ADR 0054). New runs are refused until ResumeAgent.

fields.name: proposed_triggers
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Triggers the latest version proposes; they have no effect until it is activated.

fields.name: approved_triggers
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Triggers of the active version: the ones in effect.

fields.name: ephemeral
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The latest version is ephemeral: each task gets a fresh sandbox without a home, deleted when
the task ends (ADR 0065 decision 13c).

fields.name: sandbox_archived_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Set while the agent's sandbox and volume are archived (ADR 0032 amendment): the home is in
its last checkpoint and the next run restores it into a fresh sandbox.

fields.name: model_setting
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The agent's own model setting (SetAgentModel); empty when it follows the version and the org
default. When set it wins over `model`, which is the latest version's.

Where the template's grants apply: one entry per grant on a connector

fields.name: ephemeral

GrantBinding binds a template grant to one of the org's connections and

fields.name: connection_id

For GitHub: repositories as owner/name. Their number must be within the

fields.name: thinking
fields.label: singular
fields.description: "on" or "off"; empty clears the setting.

messages.name: SetAgentTriggersRequest

fields.name: base_version
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Must equal the agent's latest_version, so a concurrent edit is not overwritten; otherwise the

fields.name: triggers
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: The complete list; empty removes every trigger.

messages.name: SetAgentTriggersResponse
messages.description: SetAgentTriggersResponse holds the agent with its new proposed version.

messages.name: ThinkingState
messages.description:
ThinkingState is the agent's thinking setting and what it resolves to (ADR 0069 amendment
2026-10-29).

fields.name: setting
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The agent's own setting: "on", "off", or empty when it follows the version and the default.

fields.name: version_setting
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The active version's value (a template's spec.model.thinking); empty when it names none.

fields.name: effective
fields.label: singular
fields.description: What the layers resolve to, "on" or "off", whether or not the model can think.

fields.name: supported
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Whether the effective model thinks. When false the setting has no effect and the UI says
"not supported by this model".

fields.name: mode
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The form the next run sends (internal/thinking.Mode): "none" when the model does not think,
"adaptive-summarized" or "default" for thinking on, "disabled" or "effort-none" for thinking off.

fields.name: always_thinks
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Whether the effective model thinks whatever the setting. A UI then offers no off choice and says
"this model always thinks"; setting "off" is refused with that message.

fields.name: off_overridden
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Whether the setting resolves to off and the model thinks anyway (it always thinks). The setting
is kept for a model that can stop; runs think.

fields.name: notice
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
What a UI shows about the setting: "this model always thinks; your off setting doesn't apply"
when off_overridden, empty otherwise.

enums.name: AgentStatus
enums.description: AgentStatus is the agent lifecycle (ADR 0020).

enums.name: ModelSource
enums.description: ModelSource says where an agent's effective model comes from, in order of precedence.

values.name: MODEL_SOURCE_AGENT
values.description: The agent's own setting (SetAgentModel).

values.name: MODEL_SOURCE_VERSION
values.description: The model of the agent's active version (a template's spec.model).

values.name: MODEL_SOURCE_ORG_DEFAULT
values.description:
The default model: the org's stored default model (ADR 0086), or the platform's
--default-model when the org has none.

values.name: MODEL_SOURCE_NONE
values.description:
Nothing: the agent, its version and the platform name no model and the org has no default
model, so a run would fail until an admin sets one.

services.name: ApprovalService
services.description:
ApprovalService shows and decides ask-tier tool calls (ADRs 0008, 0042,
0049; plan item P1). An agent's call is recorded exactly; approving it binds
to the SHA-256 of its canonical arguments, and Koinon then executes exactly
that call (for create_pull_request: the branch, the commit and the pull
request through the GitHub API; the agent never pushes) and resumes the
parked run with the result. Viewers see every request; only admins and
owners decide (ADR 0049: the default approver policy).

methods.name: Approve
methods.description:
Approve approves a pending request and executes it. args_sha256 must be
the hash shown with the request; a different hash fails with ABORTED
(HTTP 409) and nothing is executed. A request that is no longer pending
fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION. Approving again with the
same hash returns the request as it is (the same pull request), without
executing it again. Admins and owners.

methods.name: Deny
methods.description:
Deny denies a pending request; the run resumes with the denial and the
note. Admins and owners.

methods.name: GetApproval
methods.description:
GetApproval returns one request with its canonical arguments, the
push-and-run risk summary and the full change. Viewers and above.

methods.name: GetApprovalDiff
methods.description:
GetApprovalDiff compares a create_pull_request request with the branch
its pull request will target (plan item W2: the full diff, collapsed
below the risk summary). Koinon reads the current version of each file
through the run's GitHub connection (contents:read, the one repository)
and returns a unified diff per file. A file it cannot compare (GitHub
error, larger than 1 MiB, not a file) carries a fallback_reason instead,
and the card shows its full new content from GetApproval. Other tools
fail with FAILED_PRECONDITION. Viewers and above.

methods.name: ListApprovalScopes
methods.description:
ListApprovalScopes returns the scopes that are active now (not revoked, not expired) for one
agent, oldest first: what the agent's page shows next to its grants. Viewers and above.

methods.name: ListApprovals
methods.description:
ListApprovals returns the org's requests, oldest first: by default those
waiting for a decision (Waiting on you), or every request of one ticket.
Viewers and above.

methods.name: RevokeApprovalScope
methods.description:
RevokeApprovalScope ends a scope at once; the agent's next matching call needs a new
approval. Revoking a scope that is already revoked returns it as it is. Admins and owners.

messages.name: Approval
messages.description: Approval is one recorded ask-tier call.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Connector type, e.g. "github".

fields.name: target
fields.label: singular
fields.description: What the call acts on, e.g. "github:acme/widgets".

fields.name: args_json
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The canonical JSON of the arguments, exactly as hashed.

fields.name: result
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The executed call's outcome, e.g. {"url": ".../pull/1", "number": 1}.

fields.name: error
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Why execution failed.

fields.name: can_decide
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Whether the caller may approve or deny it (admins and owners, while it
is pending).

fields.name: approvals_required
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
approvals_required is 2 when the tool needs two approvers (a distinct second person, neither of
them the ticket's creator), else 1.

fields.name: first_approver
fields.label: singular
fields.description: first_approver is the user ID of the first of two approvals, once given; the request stays pending.

fields.name: mcp
fields.label: singular
fields.description: mcp is set for a call to a remote MCP server (connector "mcp").

fields.name: saved_work
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
saved_work is set for "Push saved work to a branch", a request Koinon makes itself after a
stuck sandbox (ADR 0054).

fields.name: system
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
system is true for a request Koinon made itself rather than an agent's tool call: the run
neither waits for it nor is told its outcome (saved work from a stuck sandbox).

fields.name: ci_paths
fields.label: repeated
fields.description:
ci_paths are the paths whose changes run CI on the connection's host: the connector's CI
paths plus the connection's configured directories. A directory ends with a slash. Only set
by GetApproval, for a request on a code host.

fields.name: ci_fold_case
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
ci_fold_case is whether the host's file system ignores case, so ci_paths match without
regard to case.

fields.name: scope_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
scope_id is the scope that let this call run without a decision; empty when a person (or the
Trusted preset) decided it. scope_kind says which kind it was.

messages.name: ApprovalScope
messages.description:
ApprovalScope is an approval that reaches beyond one call. Matching is exact on agent,
connector, tool and target; arguments are not part of it.

fields.name: task_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Set for a task scope.

messages.name: ApproveRequest
messages.description: ApproveRequest names a request and the hash the approver saw.

fields.name: note
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Optional; shown on the ticket.

fields.name: scope
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
scope widens the approval beyond this call: SCOPE_KIND_TASK or SCOPE_KIND_AGENT (unspecified
and once are this call only). Needs an admin or owner (the same role as approving), and fails
with INVALID_ARGUMENT for a request that needs two approvers or that Koinon made itself.
Applies when the approval takes effect (the second approval of two is never scoped).

fields.name: scope_until
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
scope_until is when a wider scope ends. Required for SCOPE_KIND_AGENT (at most one year
ahead); a task scope defaults to 30 days and may not be longer than that.

messages.name: ApproveResponse
messages.description:
ApproveResponse holds the request after execution: executed with its
result, failed with an error, or still approved if execution is retried.

messages.name: CommentCall
messages.description: CommentCall is comment_on_issue's arguments.

messages.name: DenyRequest
messages.description: DenyRequest names a request.

fields.name: note
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Optional; sent to the agent and shown on the ticket.

messages.name: DenyResponse
messages.description: DenyResponse holds the denied request.

messages.name: FileChange
messages.description:
FileChange is one file of a proposed pull request, with its full new
content: the diff data the card shows collapsed.

fields.name: executable
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The file is written as executable (git mode 100755). Otherwise a new file
is regular (100644) and a modified file keeps its mode on the base branch.
Symbolic links and submodules are never written.

messages.name: FileDiff
messages.description: FileDiff compares one file with its current version on the base branch.

fields.name: unified_diff
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
A unified diff with three lines of context: "--- a/<path>" and
"+++ b/<path>" (/dev/null for an added or deleted file), then "@@"
hunks of " ", "-" and "+" lines; "\ No newline at end of file" follows a
last line without one. Empty when the file is unchanged, binary, or
fallback_reason is set.

fields.name: binary
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The new or the current version is not text; no content is shown.

fields.name: fallback_reason
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Why there is no diff, e.g. "the current version is larger than 1 MiB".
The card then shows the full new content.

fields.name: old_mode
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The file's git mode on the base branch ("100644", "100755"; empty for a
new file) and the mode Koinon writes it with (empty for a deleted file).
Both are empty when the base tree could not be read. A modified file
whose modes differ becomes executable.

messages.name: GetApprovalDiffRequest
messages.description: GetApprovalDiffRequest names a request.

messages.name: GetApprovalDiffResponse
messages.description:
GetApprovalDiffResponse holds one FileDiff per file of the call, in the
call's order.

fields.name: base
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The branch compared against: the call's base, or the repository's
default branch. Empty if it could not be resolved.

messages.name: GetApprovalRequest
messages.description: GetApprovalRequest names a request.

messages.name: GetApprovalResponse
messages.description: GetApprovalResponse holds the request with its decoded call.

messages.name: LeakGuard
messages.description:
LeakGuard is what the MCP leak guard recorded on a card (ADR 0091): the reasons it stopped the
call, the tool's sink class, the call's address arguments, and the two legs of the session.

fields.name: reasons
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: reasons are the guard's reason codes, e.g. "both_legs" and "taint".

fields.name: destination
fields.label: map
fields.description: destination holds the call's address arguments by name.

fields.name: untrusted_input
fields.label: singular
fields.description: untrusted_input: the session read input an attacker could have written.

fields.name: private_data
fields.label: singular
fields.description: private_data: the session read data the org keeps private.

messages.name: ListApprovalsRequest
messages.description: ListApprovalsRequest names the org and, optionally, a ticket.

fields.name: ticket_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
With a ticket, every request of the ticket in any status; without, the
org's pending requests.

messages.name: ListApprovalsResponse
messages.description: ListApprovalsResponse holds the requests, without their decoded calls.

messages.name: McpCall
messages.description:
McpCall describes a call to a remote MCP server (ADR 0057). The call is bound to the server, its URL
and the version of the tool's description and schema at the time of the request.

fields.name: content_hash
fields.label: singular
fields.description: content_hash is the SHA-256 of the tool's description and schema the request was made against.

fields.name: current_content_hash
fields.label: singular
fields.description: current_content_hash is the tool's version now; when it differs the call will not run.

fields.name: review_reason
fields.label: singular
fields.description: review_reason is set while the tool is flagged for review (its description or schema changed).

fields.name: tool_description
fields.label: singular
fields.description: tool_description is the tool's current description, so the approver reads what the agent read.

fields.name: leak_guard
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
leak_guard is set when the leak guard (ADR 0091) put this call on a card: why, and which legs
the session held.

messages.name: PullRequestCall
messages.description: PullRequestCall is create_pull_request's arguments.

fields.name: branch
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The new branch Koinon creates (always under koinon/).

fields.name: base
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The branch to merge into; empty means the repository's default branch.

messages.name: Risk
messages.description:
Risk is the push-and-run summary the approval card leads with (plan item
W2). Lists hold repository paths.

fields.name: ci
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: CI and automation configuration (workflow files are refused outright).

fields.name: scripts
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Files tooling or people execute: scripts, Makefiles, hooks.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Dependency manifests and lock files.

fields.name: executable
fields.label: repeated
fields.description:
Files the call marks executable (git mode 100755); a marked file that is
already executable on the base branch is listed too. Unmarked files keep
their mode.

messages.name: SavedFile
messages.description: SavedFile is one file of saved work.

fields.name: status
fields.label: singular
fields.description: status is A (added), M (modified) or D (deleted).

messages.name: SavedWorkCall
messages.description:
SavedWorkCall describes uncommitted work saved from a stuck sandbox, as a diffstat. The files
stay sealed in Koinon until the request is approved and pushed.

fields.name: repository
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
repository is owner/name; base the commit the changes apply to; branch where they are pushed
(never the default branch).

fields.name: skipped
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Notes on changes that were not saved (symbolic links, submodules).

fields.name: status
fields.label: singular
fields.description: status is saved, pushed or expired; the work is kept 14 days.

enums.name: Decision
enums.description: Decision is what the grant's preset decided for the call.

values.name: DECISION_ASK
values.description: A human decides (the Standard preset).

values.name: DECISION_ALLOW
values.description: Executed without a card (the Trusted preset).

enums.name: FileStatus
enums.description: FileStatus is what a proposed pull request does to one file.

values.name: FILE_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED
values.description: The current version could not be read (see fallback_reason).

enums.name: ScopeKind
enums.description: ScopeKind is how far an approval reaches (ADR 0042 amendment, ADR 0065 decision 10a).

values.name: SCOPE_KIND_UNSPECIFIED
values.description: SCOPE_KIND_UNSPECIFIED means once: this exact call, as before.

values.name: SCOPE_KIND_ONCE
values.description: SCOPE_KIND_ONCE is this exact call only.

values.name: SCOPE_KIND_TASK
values.description:
SCOPE_KIND_TASK: later calls of this agent to the same connector, tool and target while
working on the same task, until the scope expires.

values.name: SCOPE_KIND_AGENT
values.description:
SCOPE_KIND_AGENT: later calls of this agent to the same connector, tool and target, in any
task, until a date.

enums.name: Status
enums.description:
Status is the ADR 0042 lifecycle: pending -> approved -> executed | failed,
or pending -> denied | expired | canceled.

services.name: AuditService
services.description:
AuditService reads the audit log (ADR 0023). The log is written by the services themselves and is
append-only; there is no way to change it here.

methods.name: List
methods.description:
List returns audit events, newest first. An org admin or owner lists the events of their org
(org_id is required for them). A platform admin names any org, or leaves org_id empty to read
every org. A caller with a lower role in the org is refused, and an org the caller is not part
of is NotFound. With scope AUDIT_SCOPE_INSTALL it returns the install chain (ADR 0100): platform
admins only, org_id must be empty, and everyone else gets PermissionDenied.

messages.name: AuditEvent
messages.description: AuditEvent is one entry of the log. summary holds {"before": .., "after": ..} without secret values.

fields.name: org_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description: org_id is empty for an install event.

fields.name: actor_kind
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
actor_kind is user, token, agent, secret, system or cli; actor_id is that actor's ID, the
declaring Secret's name for secret, or the command for cli (keys forget).

fields.name: action
fields.label: singular
fields.description: action reads <area>.<verb>, for example approval.approve or agent.archive.

fields.name: chain_seq
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
chain_seq, prev_hash and hash are the org's hash chain (the install chain for an install event),
the hashes in lower-case hex. See ADR 0023 and ADR 0100.

fields.name: org_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
org_id names the org. Only a platform admin may leave it empty, to read every org. With scope
AUDIT_SCOPE_INSTALL it must be empty.

fields.name: since
fields.label: singular
fields.description: since and until bound created_at: since <= created_at < until. Both are optional.

fields.name: action_prefix
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
action_prefix keeps the events whose action starts with it, for example "approval." or
"agent.create". Lower-case letters, digits and . _ - only.

fields.name: actor_kind
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
actor_kind keeps the events of one kind of actor; actor_id narrows that to one actor and needs
actor_kind.

fields.name: page_size

fields.name: page_token

scope defaults to the org scope (unspecified or AUDIT_SCOPE_ORG). AUDIT_SCOPE_INSTALL needs a
platform admin.

fields.name: next_page_token

fields.description: next_page_token is empty on the last page.

enums.name: AuditScope

values.name: AUDIT_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED
values.description: AUDIT_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED reads the org scope, as before the install chain existed.

values.name: AUDIT_SCOPE_ORG

values.name: AUDIT_SCOPE_INSTALL

services.name: AuthService
services.description:
AuthService describes the caller's session. Login and logout are plain
HTTP endpoints (/auth/login, /auth/oidc/start, /auth/oidc/callback,
/auth/logout) because they set and clear the session cookie and redirect.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description:
ChangePassword replaces the bootstrap admin's password. It is the only
call besides WhoAmI allowed while a password change is required. Other
sessions of the user are revoked.

methods.name: WhoAmI
methods.description: WhoAmI returns the authenticated principal.

messages.name: ChangePasswordRequest
messages.description: ChangePasswordRequest carries the current and the new password.

fields.name: new_password
fields.label: singular
fields.description: At least 12 characters and different from the current password.

messages.name: ChangePasswordResponse
messages.description: ChangePasswordResponse is empty.

messages.name: Membership

messages.name: User
messages.description: User is the authenticated human.

messages.description: WhoAmIRequest is empty.

messages.name: WhoAmIResponse
messages.description: WhoAmIResponse describes the caller.

fields.name: password_change_required
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
True until the bootstrap admin replaces the one-time password. While set,
every call except WhoAmI and ChangePassword fails with PermissionDenied.

enums.name: AuthMethod
enums.description: AuthMethod is how the session was established.

values.name: AUTH_METHOD_PASSWORD
values.description: The bootstrap admin's local password.

values.name: AUTH_METHOD_OIDC
values.description: OpenID Connect authorization code flow.

enums.name: OrgRole
enums.description: OrgRole mirrors the org_role enum in Postgres, lowest to highest.

services.name: BudgetService
services.description:
BudgetService sets an org's monthly cap and its agents' daily limits and lists the in-app
notifications about them (plan item BG1, ADR 0056). Amounts are USD decimal strings.
The cap is per calendar month in UTC, an agent's limit per UTC day. Admins and owners write;
the platform ceiling is for platform admins. Every change is audited.

methods.name: GetAgentBudget
methods.description: GetAgentBudget returns an agent's effective daily limit and today's spend.

methods.name: GetAgentRunLimits
methods.description:
GetAgentRunLimits returns the limits a run of the agent gets: the effective values, the
template's defaults and the admin's overrides (ADR 0081).

methods.name: GetOrgBudget
methods.description: GetOrgBudget returns the cap, the platform ceiling and this month's spend.

methods.name: ListAgentBudgets
methods.description:
ListAgentBudgets returns every agent's effective daily limit, template default and
today's spend.

methods.name: ListNotifications
methods.description:
ListNotifications returns the caller's notifications in this org, newest first: budget
warnings at 80% and stops at 100%. Owners and admins receive them; platform admins also
those about the platform ceiling.

methods.name: ListOrgBudgets
methods.description:
ListOrgBudgets returns every org's cap, platform ceiling and spend this month. Platform
admins only.

methods.name: MarkNotificationRead
methods.description: MarkNotificationRead marks one of the caller's notifications read.

methods.name: SetAgentBudget
methods.description:
SetAgentBudget sets an agent's daily limit. A template's spendUSD is only the default for
a new agent.

methods.name: SetAgentRunLimits
methods.description:
SetAgentRunLimits replaces the agent's overrides of its run limits. A zero value clears that
override; all zero clears them all. It applies to runs queued afterwards.

methods.name: SetMonthlyCap
methods.description: SetMonthlyCap sets the cap, or clears it with an empty amount. It cannot exceed the ceiling.

methods.name: SetPlatformCeiling
methods.description:
SetPlatformCeiling sets the org's ceiling, or clears it with an empty amount. Platform
admins only. The org's cap must already fit under it.

services.name: PriceService
services.description:
PriceService manages an org's own prices and shows the default price list (plan item PV2,
ADR 0056). A price is a rate per usage type, in USD per million tokens, for non-overlapping
buckets of a request; org prices win over the default list. Admins and owners.

methods.name: GetDefaultPriceChanges
methods.description:
GetDefaultPriceChanges returns what changed between two versions of the default list. An
empty from_version means the version before to_version; an empty to_version the current one.

methods.name: GetDefaultPrices
methods.description: GetDefaultPrices returns the default list this installation runs.

methods.name: ListFlaggedPrices
methods.description:
ListFlaggedPrices returns price entries whose recomputed cost differs from the gateway's
by more than 1%.

methods.name: ListPrices
methods.description: ListPrices returns every version of the org's prices, newest first per name.

methods.name: RetirePrice
methods.description: RetirePrice ends a named price now. Its versions stay for the ledger entries that cite them.

methods.name: SetPrice
methods.description:
SetPrice adds a version of a named price. Earlier versions never change, and requests
before valid_from keep the price they were charged at.

fields.name: agent_name
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
agent_name and template_default_usd are set by ListAgentBudgets. The default is the
spendUSD of the agent's active version.

fields.name: effective
fields.label: singular
fields.description: effective is what a run queued now gets: the override, else the template's value.

fields.name: template_default
fields.label: singular
fields.description: template_default is the agent's active version (the template's values).

fields.name: override
fields.label: singular
fields.description: override is what an admin set; unset fields follow the template.

fields.name: gateway_diff
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Requests per reason; one request can have several. gateway_diff: Koinon's cost differs
from the gateway's by more than 1%. usage_missing: the provider reported no usage, so the
request was estimated. max_output_capped: an estimated output was capped at the price's
max_output. price_error: the stored price could not be used.

fields.name: since
fields.label: singular
fields.description: since defaults to 7 days ago.

fields.name: max_results
fields.label: singular
fields.description: max_results defaults to 50 and is at most 200.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: singular
fields.description: kind is budget.warning (80%), budget.reached (100%) or agent.unhealthy.

fields.name: level
fields.label: singular
fields.description: level is agent_daily, org_monthly or platform_ceiling.

fields.name: threshold
fields.label: singular
fields.description: threshold is 80 or 100.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description: agent_id is set for agent_daily.

fields.name: read_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description: read_at is unset while the notification is unread.

fields.name: message
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
message is the text of notifications that are not about a budget (kind agent.unhealthy: an
agent whose sandbox keeps getting stuck; agent_id names it).

fields.name: monthly_cap_usd
fields.label: singular
fields.description: monthly_cap_usd is empty when there is no cap.

fields.name: platform_ceiling_usd
fields.label: singular
fields.description: platform_ceiling_usd is empty when the ceiling is off.

fields.name: estimated_this_month_usd
fields.label: singular
fields.description: estimated_this_month_usd is the part of the spend that came from estimated usage.

fields.name: system_checks_this_month_usd
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
system_checks_this_month_usd is the part of the spend that came from Koinon's own requests
(the provider echo check), which belong to no agent. It counts toward the cap.

fields.name: monthly_cap_usd
fields.label: singular
fields.description: monthly_cap_usd and platform_ceiling_usd are empty when unset.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: singular
fields.description: kind is added, removed or changed.

messages.name: PriceMatch
messages.description: PriceMatch holds exactly one of glob and regex.

messages.name: PriceTier
messages.description:
PriceTier replaces the rates it names once the input side of a request (input, cache reads
and cache writes) exceeds context_over tokens.

fields.name: id
fields.label: singular
fields.description: id is cited by ledger entries as org#<id>.

fields.name: needs_review
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
needs_review is set for a price migrated from a model's rates whose estimation settings are
generic because no default entry matched; an admin should check them.

messages.name: Rates
messages.description:
Rates are USD per million tokens as decimal strings with at most 6 fraction digits. Empty
means unset; a free model needs an explicit "0".

messages.name: RunLimitValues
messages.description: RunLimitValues are the limits of one run. Zero (or empty) means unset.

fields.name: max_model_requests
fields.label: singular
fields.description: max_model_requests counts every model request through the agent's key.

fields.name: max_spend_usd
fields.label: singular
fields.description: max_spend_usd is a USD decimal string.

fields.name: max_duration_seconds
fields.label: singular
fields.description: max_duration_seconds is the wall-clock limit.

fields.name: tokenizer
fields.label: singular
fields.description: tokenizer is bytes (default), tiktoken:o200k_base or tiktoken:cl100k_base.

fields.name: ratio
fields.label: singular
fields.description: ratio is UTF-8 bytes per token for estimates; default 3.0.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.label: singular
fields.description: valid_from defaults to now.

fields.name: max_output
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
max_output is the largest output in tokens; required unless every rate is "0". An aborted
response without usage settles at no more than this.

fields.name: warnings
fields.label: repeated
fields.description:
warnings are non-fatal notes about the saved entry, for example that a model with a
cache_read price runs without prompt caching because Koinon has no cache mode for its
provider format (ADR 0068).

services.name: ConnectionService
services.description:
ConnectionService manages an org's connections to external systems
(ADR 0007): one configured instance of a connector type, such as one GitHub
App installation. Secrets entered here are sealed straight into the encrypted
secret store (ADR 0021, 0056); no response ever contains them.

methods.name: CreateGitHubConnection
methods.description:
CreateGitHubConnection creates a GitHub App connection. The private key
is stored encrypted and never returned. Admins and owners.

methods.name: CreateGiteaConnection
methods.description:
CreateGiteaConnection creates a Gitea connection: a bot account on a Gitea server with a read
token and a write token (ADR 0063). Both tokens are stored encrypted and never returned.
Admins and owners.

methods.name: DeleteConnection
methods.description:
DeleteConnection deletes a connection and its stored secret fields for good. A connection entered
here can be deleted; a declared one only after its Secret was deleted (removed). While agents are
bound to it the call fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION and lists them. Audited. Admins and owners.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: GetConnection returns one connection. Viewers and above.

methods.name: ListConnections
methods.description:
ListConnections returns the org's connections, oldest first. Viewers and
above.

methods.name: ListConnectorTypes
methods.description:
ListConnectorTypes returns the connector types this install ships, with
their scopes and setup guides. Any signed-in user.

methods.name: ListInstallationRepos
methods.description:
ListInstallationRepos lists the repositories a GitHub connection's App
installation can access, for choosing what to bind an agent to. Koinon
asks GitHub with a metadata-read installation token; nothing is written.
Admins and owners.

methods.name: SetConnectionSecret
methods.description:
SetConnectionSecret replaces the secret fields of a connection entered here: a GitHub App's private
key, or a Gitea connection's two tokens. It is how a secret lost with its key-encryption key is
entered again (ADR 0085 decision 13), and how one is rotated. Every secret field of the connector
is required; the other settings stay. It clears the lost mark and the last test result. A
declared connection's secret is changed in its Kubernetes Secret instead (FAILED_PRECONDITION).
Audited without the secret. Admins and owners.

methods.name: TestConnection
methods.description:
TestConnection runs the setup guide's checks against the provider and
records the result. Nothing is written to the provider. Admins and owners.

messages.name: BoundAgents
messages.description:
BoundAgents is the error detail of a DeleteConnection refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION because
agents are still bound to the connection.

messages.name: CheckResult
messages.description: CheckResult is one setup-guide check.

fields.name: check
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The check's name, e.g. github.installation.

fields.name: step
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The setup-guide step it validates, so the UI can point at it.

fields.name: message
fields.label: singular
fields.description: What went wrong, or what was found. Never contains secrets.

messages.name: Connection
messages.description: Connection is a configured connector instance.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Connector type ID, e.g. github.

fields.name: source
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
source is "ui" for a connection entered here and "secret" for one declared by a
labelled Kubernetes Secret (ADR 0056), which is managed_by_secret.

fields.name: removed
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
removed is set when the declaring Secret was deleted. The connection stays, for the audit log and
the agents bound to it, but is not usable: bound agents report why and runs that need it fail
with that reason. Restoring the Secret restores the connection.

fields.name: credential_lost_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
credential_lost_at is set when the secret was lost with the key that encrypted it (`koinon-api keys
forget`, ADR 0085 decision 13): the connection is not usable (bound agents report it and runs that need it fail) until the
secret is entered again. Unset otherwise.

fields.name: admin_disabled
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
admin_disabled is set while an admin holds the target off (the outward switch, ADR 0110 decision 5): it is
not called, probed or offered to runs. Unset otherwise.

messages.name: ConnectorType
messages.description: ConnectorType is a platform-curated connector type.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.label: singular
fields.description: "app-credential", "federated" or "delegated-user".

fields.name: document
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The whole connector type document as JSON, setup guide included; its
shape is connectors/schema/connector.schema.json.

messages.name: CreateGitHubConnectionRequest
messages.description: CreateGitHubConnectionRequest carries the setup guide's fields.

fields.name: private_key

fields.description:
Secure input (ADR 0021): the App's PEM private key. Stored only as an
envelope in Postgres (ADR 0056), never returned or logged.

fields.name: test

fields.description: Run TestConnection right after creating it.

fields.name: base_url

fields.description:
Web base URL of a GitHub Enterprise Server host, https://host[:port]. Empty
is github.com. The REST API is reached at /api/v3 on the same host.

PEM certificates that sign the host's TLS certificate, when the system

Directories that run CI on this host besides the connector's own CI paths, relative to the

messages.name: CreateGiteaConnectionRequest

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The server's web base URL, https://host[:port][/path]. Required.

fields.description:
Secure input (ADR 0021): the bot's read token and write token. Stored only as an envelope in
Postgres (ADR 0056), never returned or logged.

fields.name: ca_bundle

fields.name: ci_dirs

fields.name: test

messages.description: CreateGiteaConnectionResponse holds the new connection and, when asked for, the test results.

messages.name: GetConnectionRequest
messages.description: GetConnectionRequest names a connection.

messages.name: GetConnectionResponse

messages.name: GitHubConnection
messages.description: GitHubConnection is the non-secret part of a GitHub App connection.

fields.name: key_fingerprint
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
SHA-256 fingerprint of the private key's public half, as GitHub shows it
under the App's private keys.

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The host's web base URL when it is not github.com (GitHub Enterprise
Server), https://host[:port]; empty for github.com.

fields.name: ca_bundle
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
PEM certificates trusted for that host besides the system roots. Public;
empty when the host's certificate chains to the system roots.

Directories, relative to the repository root, that run CI on this host besides the
connector's own CI paths (a Gitea server's WORKFLOW_DIRS). create_pull_request refuses
changes to them.

messages.name: GitHubConnectionSecret
messages.description: GitHubConnectionSecret is the secret field of a GitHub App connection.

fields.name: private_key
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Secure input (ADR 0021): the App's PEM private key, a new one or the one GitHub still lists.
Stored only as an envelope in Postgres (ADR 0056), never returned or logged.

messages.name: GiteaConnection
messages.description: GiteaConnection is the non-secret part of a Gitea connection (ADR 0063).

fields.name: base_url

fields.description: The server's web base URL, https://host[:port][/path]; the REST API is at /api/v1 under it.

fields.name: ca_bundle

fields.name: ci_dirs

fields.description:
Directories, relative to the repository root, that run CI on this server besides the
connector's own CI paths (WORKFLOW_DIRS).

fields.name: read_token_set_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
When each token was entered in Koinon. Gitea does not expose a token's creation date, so
this is the age Koinon can show (ADR 0063).

fields.name: token_warn_after_seconds
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
The age after which Koinon warns that a token is old, from the connector type. Nothing
blocks on age and Koinon never rotates a token. Zero for no warning.

messages.name: GiteaConnectionSecret
messages.description: GiteaConnectionSecret is the secret fields of a Gitea connection (ADR 0063).

fields.description:
Secure input (ADR 0021): the bot's read token and write token, both required. A token equal to
the stored one keeps the date it was entered. Stored only as an envelope, never returned or logged.

messages.name: InstallationRepo

fields.name: full_name

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.label: singular

Empty on the last page. A filtered page can hold fewer repositories than
an unfiltered one, or none, and still have a next page.

fields.name: total_count

fields.name: tools

fields.description: MCP tools the scope exposes behind agentgateway.

SetConnectionSecretRequest names a connection and carries its new secret fields. The secret's

fields.description: Run TestConnection right after storing the secret.

messages.name: TestConnectionRequest

messages.name: TestConnectionResponse

enums.name: ConnectionStatus

enums.name: Tier
enums.description: Tier is a scope's risk tier (ADR 0008).

services.name: LeakGuardService
services.description:
LeakGuardService manages an org's leak-guard settings (ADR 0084): the match threshold and the
fetch-trusted host list the automatic URL rule exempts. It is the connect-rpc face of the same
service layer the admin API uses. Admins and owners only. Every change is audited.

methods.name: AddTrustedHost
methods.description:
AddTrustedHost puts a host on the fetch-trusted list. A host already on it changes nothing.
Audited as org.fetch_trusted_host.add.

methods.name: RemoveTrustedHost
methods.description:
RemoveTrustedHost takes a host off the list; NOT_FOUND when it was not on it. Audited as
org.fetch_trusted_host.remove.

methods.name: SetMatchThreshold
methods.description:
SetMatchThreshold sets the match threshold, or returns it to the default (24) when
match_threshold is 0. Audited as org.leak_guard.threshold.set.

fields.name: host
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
host is a bare DNS name such as docs.example.com (exactly that host), or *. and a DNS name such as
*.example.com (any subdomain at any depth, not example.com itself). A wildcard over a public suffix is refused.

messages.name: CodeHostScope
messages.description:
CodeHostScope counts the repositories of the org's code-host connections by the visibility the
connector last read. The code-host derivation calls a write internal only for a listed repository
that is not public and whose reading is fresh; unknown and stale ones count as external-high.

fields.name: stale
fields.label: singular
fields.description: stale counts the readings older than visibility_max_age_seconds.

fields.name: oldest_checked_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description: oldest_checked_at is the oldest reading; unset for an empty scope.

messages.name: LeakGuard
messages.description: LeakGuard is the org's effective configuration.

fields.name: match_threshold
fields.label: singular
fields.description: match_threshold is the shortest tainted text, in characters after normalisation, that blocks a call.

fields.name: trusted_hosts
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: trusted_hosts is the fetch-trusted host list, sorted; empty for a new org.

fields.name: code_host_scope
fields.label: singular
fields.description: code_host_scope summarises the org's code-host scope (ADR 0091 decision 3).

fields.name: match_threshold
fields.label: singular
fields.description: match_threshold in characters; 0 returns it to the default.

services.name: McpServerService
services.description:
McpServerService manages an org's remote MCP servers (ADR 0057) for the UI. It is the connect-rpc
face of the same service layer the admin API uses, so validation, the upstream URL policy and the
audit trail are the same. Admins and owners only: members do not see servers.

Servers declared by a labelled Kubernetes Secret (source "secret") are read-only: changing or
deleting a live one fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION and names the Secret. Their tools' tiers can still
be set here. Credentials are write-only; they are never returned.

methods.name: AcknowledgeToolReview
methods.description: AcknowledgeToolReview clears a tool's review flag without changing its tier.

methods.name: CreateServer
methods.description:
CreateServer adds a server. A server that asks each user to sign in with OAuth is refused with
INVALID_ARGUMENT (planned for v0.2).

methods.name: DeleteServer
methods.description:
DeleteServer deletes a server entered here, with its tools and the agents' allowances of it. A
declared server can be deleted only after its Secret was deleted (removed).

methods.name: GetAgentServers
methods.description: GetAgentServers returns the servers an agent may use.

methods.name: ListTools
methods.description: ListTools returns the tools of one server, or of all the org's servers when server_id is empty.

methods.name: SetAgentServers
methods.description: SetAgentServers replaces the servers an agent may use.

methods.name: SetServerClass
methods.description:
SetServerClass sets what a server exposes: its kind and the legs of the leak guard (ADR 0084) it
carries. It works for declared servers too, which the declaring Secret does not describe. Audited
as mcp_server.data_class.set.

methods.name: SetToolSink
methods.description:
SetToolSink declares a tool's sink class, address arguments and result legs (ADR 0091). The
request names the content hash of the tool the admin reviewed; if the server republished the tool
since, the call fails with ABORTED (HTTP 409) and nothing changes. Audited as
mcp_tool.declaration.set. A changed server URL or tool content hash puts the declaration back to
the default, audited as mcp_tool.declaration.reset.

methods.name: SetToolTier
methods.description: SetToolTier moves a tool to a tier and clears its review flag.

methods.name: SetToolTwoApprovers
methods.description:
SetToolTwoApprovers turns on or off the requirement that a call to the tool in the ask tier needs
two approvers: distinct admins or owners, neither the ticket's creator. Off by default.

messages.name: Allowance
messages.description: Allowance is a server an agent may use, optionally narrowed to some of its tools.

fields.name: tools
fields.label: repeated
fields.description:
tools narrows the allowance; empty allows the whole server, including tools it adds later (which
enter the ask tier).

fields.name: transport
fields.label: singular
fields.description: transport defaults to "streamable-http".

fields.name: credential_header
fields.label: singular
fields.description: credential_header defaults to Authorization when credential_value is set.

fields.name: credential_prefix
fields.label: singular
fields.description: credential_prefix precedes the secret in the header value, for example "Bearer ".

fields.name: class
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
class is what the server exposes; leaving it out is the unclassified default (kind "other", both
legs).

messages.name: Server
messages.description: Server is a remote MCP server of the org. It never holds the credential.

fields.name: transport
fields.label: singular
fields.description: transport is "streamable-http" or "sse".

fields.name: source
fields.label: singular
fields.description: source is "ui" for a server entered here and "secret" for one declared by a Secret.

fields.name: disabled_reason
fields.label: singular
fields.description: disabled_reason says why the server is not served, empty when it is.

fields.name: removed
fields.label: singular
fields.description: removed is set when the declaring Secret was deleted.

fields.name: gateway_target
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
gateway_target is the name of the server's target in the gateway, "<org slug>-<name>", which is
also the prefix of its tools in an agent's tool list.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
kind is "fetch", "search" or "other"; data_class lists the session legs the server's results can
set, in the order untrusted_input, private_data (see ServerClass). A server nobody classified is
kind "other" with both legs.

fields.name: code_host_connection_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
code_host_connection_id is the org's code-host connection the server acts through, empty for none.
The code-host sink class of its tools is looked up in that connection's repository list only; a
server without one is external-high. A changed URL clears it.

fields.name: credential_lost_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
credential_lost_at is set when the credential was lost with the key that encrypted it (`koinon-api keys
forget`, ADR 0085 decision 13): the server is not served until the credential is entered again; has_credential
is false and credential_header and credential_prefix are kept, so only the value is asked for. Unset otherwise.

fields.name: admin_disabled
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
admin_disabled is set while an admin holds the target off (the outward switch, ADR 0110 decision 5): it is
not called, probed or offered to runs. Unset otherwise.

messages.name: ServerClass
messages.description: ServerClass is what a server declares it exposes (ADR 0084 decision 8).

fields.name: kind
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
kind is "fetch" (reads web pages or other untrusted documents), "search" (sends a query to a
search provider) or "other".

fields.name: data_class
fields.label: repeated
fields.description:
data_class are the session legs the server's results can set (ADR 0091), any of "untrusted_input"
(returns text an outsider controls) and "private_data" (returns data the org does not want to
leave). A server may carry both; none is allowed. Where a call goes is not a server leg: it is the
sink class of each tool (ToolSink).

fields.name: code_host_connection_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
code_host_connection_id links the server to one of the org's code-host connections (see Server).
Empty means none.

fields.name: content_hash
fields.label: singular
fields.description: content_hash is the Tool.content_hash the admin reviewed. Required.

fields.name: read_only_hint
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
read_only_hint is the server's own readOnlyHint annotation: a suggestion for the admin, who decides
the tier.

fields.name: review_reason
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
review_reason is set while the tool's description or input schema changed since an admin last
reviewed it. It does not block the tool.

fields.name: present
fields.label: singular
fields.description: present is false once the server stopped listing the tool.

fields.name: requires_two_approvers
fields.label: singular
fields.description: requires_two_approvers: a call in the ask tier needs two approvers.

fields.name: content_hash
fields.label: singular
fields.description: content_hash identifies the description and input schema as last published.

fields.name: unavailable
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
unavailable says why agents are not offered the tool ("unavailable: name too long ..."); empty when
they are.

fields.name: description_original_length
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
description is the sanitised text (ADR 0057 amendment, #52). description_original_length is the
length in characters of the description as the server published it; description_capped says it,
or a description in the input schema, was cut to its cap; description_cleaned says control,
invisible or tag characters were removed or harness-lookalike tags escaped.

fields.name: sink
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
sink is the tool's declaration for the leak guard (ADR 0091). A tool nobody declared is
external-high with the server's legs.

messages.name: ToolSink
messages.description: ToolSink is what a tool declares about its calls (ADR 0091 decision 2).

fields.name: sink_class
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
sink_class is "none", "internal", "external-low" or "external-high": the fixed class of the tool.
For a derived tool it is the class of a call whose address arguments do not parse, always
"external-high".

fields.name: derivation
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
derivation is "fixed" (use sink_class), "code_host" (internal only for a non-public repository of
the org's code-host scope; address_args are the owner and repo arguments, in that order) or "fetch"
(internal for a fetch-trusted host, otherwise external-low; address_args is the url argument).

fields.name: address_args
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: address_args name the arguments that say where a call goes. Every other argument is payload.

fields.name: result_untrusted_input
fields.label: optional
fields.description:
result_untrusted_input and result_private_data say what the tool's results carry for the session
legs. Unset is the server's own leg.

fields.name: url
fields.label: optional
fields.description: Fields left unset stay.

fields.name: credential_header
fields.label: optional
fields.description:
Setting any of the credential fields replaces the credential's header and prefix; credential_value
replaces the secret, and leaving it out keeps the stored one.

values.name: HEALTH_UNHEALTHY
values.description: UNHEALTHY: three probes in a row failed; the server's tools are withdrawn from agents.

values.name: TIER_ASK
values.description: ASK: a human approves each call (ADR 0008, 0042). Every new tool starts here.

values.name: TIER_AUTO
values.description: AUTO: the agent calls the tool directly.

values.name: TIER_NEVER
values.description: NEVER: no agent may call the tool.

services.name: OrgSettingsService
services.description:
OrgSettingsService is the UI's face of the org's settings that are not owned by another service
(leak guard and trace settings have their own). It is the connect-rpc face of the same service
layer the admin API uses. Admins and owners only. Every change is audited.

methods.name: SetHomeBackupRetention
methods.description:
SetHomeBackupRetention sets how long an old home backup repository is kept after a key change, or
returns it to the default (7 days) when days is 0. Audited as org.home_backup_retention.set.

methods.name: SetRunContentRetention
methods.description:
SetRunContentRetention sets how long a finished run's stored content is kept, or returns it to the
default (30 days) when days is 0. Audited as org.run_content_retention.set.

messages.name: HomeBackupRetention
messages.description:
HomeBackupRetention is the org's effective retention of old home backup repositories. A key change
starts a new backup repository for each agent's home; the old one stays readable for the
checkpoints written to it for days, then it is deleted. The deadline is set when the new repository
starts, so a change applies to later key changes only.

messages.name: RunContentRetention
messages.description:
RunContentRetention is the org's effective retention of stored run content. Once a finished run is
older than days, the purge job blanks the payload of its content events (messages, thoughts and tool
calls) and strips the text from prompt, permission and refusal events, whose state fields stay. Other
events, the run's status, traces and the spend ledger stay.

fields.name: days
fields.label: singular
fields.description: days to keep an old home backup repository; 0 returns it to the default.

fields.name: days
fields.label: singular
fields.description: days to keep a finished run's content; 0 returns it to the default.

services.name: OutwardService
services.description:
OutwardService is the one switch for everything Koinon calls outside the install (ADR 0110 decision 5):
MCP servers, model providers, code-host connections and trace destinations. A disabled target is not
called, not probed and not offered to runs; it keeps its bindings and its credential. It is the
connect-rpc face of the same service layer the admin REST API uses. Every change is audited as
outward.disable or outward.enable.

methods.name: SetOutwardTargetDisabled
methods.description:
SetOutwardTargetDisabled disables or enables one target. Org admins and owners switch the org's own
targets; the platform trace destination needs a platform admin. Disabling is allowed while the install
is held for a restore; enabling is refused then with FAILED_PRECONDITION. A target whose declaring
Secret says disabled: true cannot be enabled here (FAILED_PRECONDITION). Setting the state a target
already has changes and audits nothing.

messages.name: AdminDisabled
messages.description: AdminDisabled is the switch as Get and List of a target show it. A target without it is enabled.

fields.name: by
fields.label: singular
fields.description: by is the actor as the audit log reads it, for example "token <id>" or "secret <name>".

fields.name: declared
fields.label: singular
fields.description: declared is true when the declaring Secret says disabled: true; the API cannot enable such a target.

fields.name: disabled_by
fields.label: singular
fields.description: disabled_by is the actor as the audit log reads it, for example "user <id>" or "secret <name>".

fields.name: note
fields.label: singular
fields.description: note says why, at most 500 characters. Kept while the target is disabled.

enums.name: OutwardTargetKind
enums.description: OutwardTargetKind is what kind of target the switch is for.

values.name: OUTWARD_TARGET_KIND_PLATFORM_TRACE_DESTINATION
values.description: The platform trace destination has one row: target_id is ignored and org_id names any org.

services.name: PlatformService
services.description:
PlatformService is the first Koinon API surface. It has no methods yet;
it exists so code generation and `buf breaking` run from day one.

services.name: ProviderService
services.description:
ProviderService manages an org's model providers and models (ADR 0056) for the UI. It is the
connect-rpc face of the same service layer the admin API uses, so validation, the upstream URL
policy and the audit trail are the same. Admins and owners only: members do not see providers.

Entries declared by a labelled Kubernetes Secret (source "secret") are read-only: changing or
deleting a live one fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION and names the Secret. Provider keys are write-only;
they are never returned.

methods.name: CheckProviderEcho
methods.description:
CheckProviderEcho runs the echo check on one model of the provider: one tiny chat request
through the gateway asking the model to repeat a fixed line exactly, to catch masking of names
and addresses on the provider's side. It is metered like any request, runs only when called
and stores the result on the provider. Admins and owners only.

methods.name: DeleteProvider
methods.description:
DeleteProvider deletes a provider entered here, with its models. A declared provider can be
deleted only after its Secret was deleted (removed).

methods.name: GetDefaultModel
methods.description:
GetDefaultModel returns the org's default model (ADR 0086), which agents without a model
setting run on, and the models it may be set to: the ones the org serves and has a price for.

methods.name: ModelFormats
methods.description:
ModelFormats says which formats a model may use on a provider and which one it gets by default
(ADR 0069), so the model form offers exactly what the server will accept.

methods.name: ProviderTypeInfo
methods.description:
ProviderTypeInfo says what a provider type offers before any provider of that type exists, so the
provider form shows only the fields the server will accept.

methods.name: SetDefaultModel
methods.description:
SetDefaultModel sets the org's default model, or clears it with an empty model. The model must
be one the org serves and has a price for. Audited as org.default_model.set.

messages.name: CheckProviderEchoRequest
messages.description: CheckProviderEchoRequest names the provider and one of its models.

fields.name: model
fields.label: singular
fields.description: A model of the provider that the org serves and has a price for.

messages.name: CheckProviderEchoResponse
messages.description: CheckProviderEchoResponse holds the result.

fields.name: rates
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
rates is deprecated: a request that sets it fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT. Add a price with
PriceService.SetPrice instead.

fields.name: format
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
format is the model's wire format, within what the provider offers. Empty means the default
(ADR 0069); a value marks the model as overridden.

fields.name: warnings
fields.label: repeated
fields.description:
warnings are non-fatal notes, for example that the model runs without prompt caching because
Koinon has no cache mode for its provider format (ADR 0068).

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: singular
fields.description: api_key is empty for keyless upstreams such as Ollama.

fields.name: anthropic_workspace_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description: anthropic_workspace_id is allowed for type "anthropic" only: wrkspc_ followed by letters and digits.

fields.name: cost_api_key
fields.label: singular

fields.name: cost_scope
fields.label: singular
fields.description: cost_scope is the cost scope of that key (see Provider.cost_scope).

messages.name: DefaultModelChoice
messages.description: DefaultModelChoice is a model the org serves and has a price for.

messages.name: EchoCheck
messages.description: EchoCheck is the result of an echo check (CheckProviderEcho).

fields.name: model
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The model the check used.

fields.name: unchanged
fields.label: singular
fields.description: True when the reply was the line, character for character.

fields.name: sent
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The line sent and the reply received.

fields.name: diff

fields.description: The difference between them, in order; every segment of an unchanged result is EQUAL.

messages.name: EchoDiffSegment

fields.name: model
fields.label: singular
fields.description: model is the org's default model; empty when the org has none.

fields.name: available
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: available are the models the default may be set to.

fields.name: name
fields.label: singular
fields.description: name is the plain name agents ask for; the gateway serves it as "<org slug>/<name>".

fields.name: guard
fields.label: singular
fields.description: guard is the routing guard, for OpenRouter providers only.

fields.name: rates
fields.label: singular
fields.description: rates is deprecated and never set; prices are org price entries (PriceService).

fields.name: format
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
format is the model's wire format: "openai" (chat completions) or "anthropic" (Messages)
(ADR 0069).

fields.name: format_overridden
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
format_overridden is set when an admin chose the format; otherwise it follows the default and
is re-derived when the default changes.

messages.name: ModelFormat
messages.description:
ModelFormat is a model wire format as the server's format table names it: id is the stored value,
label how it reads to a person. The set is open and grows with the formats Koinon supports.

fields.name: name
fields.label: singular
fields.description: name is the model name; the default depends on its family.

fields.name: default_format
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
default_format is the id of the format the model gets unless overridden. The formats the
provider offers are Provider.formats.

messages.name: Provider
messages.description: Provider is an upstream model API of the org. It never holds the key.

fields.name: type
fields.label: singular
fields.description: type is the agentgateway provider name, such as openai, openrouter or ollama.

fields.name: has_key
fields.label: singular
fields.description: has_key is whether an API key is stored.

fields.name: source
fields.label: singular
fields.description: source is "ui" for a provider entered here and "secret" for one declared by a Secret.

fields.name: disabled_reason
fields.label: singular
fields.description: disabled_reason says why the provider is not served, empty when it is.

fields.name: removed
fields.label: singular
fields.description: removed is set when the declaring Secret was deleted.

fields.name: anthropic_workspace_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
anthropic_workspace_id is the Anthropic workspace the gateway names for the provider's models,
for an API key not scoped to a workspace. Empty when unset. An identifier, not a credential.

fields.name: formats
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: formats are the model formats the provider's type offers, preferred first (ADR 0069).

fields.name: echo_check
fields.label: singular
fields.description: echo_check is the latest echo check of the provider; unset when none ran.

fields.name: credential_lost_at
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
credential_lost_at is set when the API key was lost with the key that encrypted it (`koinon-api keys
forget`, ADR 0085 decision 13): the provider is not served until the key is entered again; has_key is false. Unset otherwise.

fields.name: has_cost_key
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
has_cost_key is whether a cost API key is stored: an admin key with which koinon-reconciler reads
the provider's cost API once a day and records the ledger's difference from it (ADR 0056,
amendment 2026-11-06). anthropic and openai providers at their own API URL only.

fields.name: cost_scope
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
cost_scope is the part of the provider's account whose cost is this provider key's: the
Anthropic workspace ID ("default" for the default workspace), or the OpenAI project ID or API
key ID (key_..., the key's ID, never the key).

fields.name: cost_key_lost_at

fields.description:
cost_key_lost_at is set when the cost API key was lost with the key that encrypted it; it must
be entered again. Unset otherwise.

fields.name: admin_disabled

fields.description:
admin_disabled is set while an admin holds the target off (the outward switch, ADR 0110 decision 5): it is
not called, probed or offered to runs. Unset otherwise.

fields.name: formats

fields.name: takes_workspace_id

fields.name: takes_cost_key
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
takes_cost_key is set when Koinon reads the type's cost API (anthropic and openai, at their own
API URL), so the provider takes a cost API key and a cost scope.

messages.name: Rates
messages.description:
Rates are deprecated: per-model rates were folded into org prices (PriceService, ADR 0056). The
message stays for wire compatibility; the server never fills it and refuses requests that set it.

back to the default and is no longer overridden.

fields.name: api_key

fields.name: anthropic_workspace_id
fields.label: optional
fields.description: anthropic_workspace_id replaces the workspace ID; set to "" it removes it.

fields.name: cost_api_key

fields.description:
cost_api_key replaces the cost API key (an Anthropic or OpenAI admin key that may read the cost
API; write-only, never returned); set to "" it removes the key and its scope.

fields.description: cost_scope replaces the cost scope; required with a cost API key (see Provider.cost_scope).

services.name: QuestionService
services.description:
QuestionService is what an agent asks a person with the ask_user tool (ADR 0065 decisions 8 and
10a). A question is addressed to a target, a person or a role, resolved to its recipients when it
is asked. Every recipient sees it in the inbox and can answer or dismiss it. The first answer
wins. Every request names the org it acts in; IDs from another org are not found.

methods.name: AnswerQuestion
methods.description:
AnswerQuestion answers an open question addressed to the caller and resumes the run. The
answer is a choice, the draft (as offered or edited) or free text. A question that is no
longer open is refused (Aborted), so an answer never resumes a run twice. Members and above.

methods.name: DismissQuestion
methods.description:
DismissQuestion dismisses an open question addressed to the caller: its safe default becomes
the answer and the agent is told. Members and above.

methods.name: ListAskableMembers
methods.description:
ListAskableMembers lists the org's members who can answer questions (member role or higher), for
picking a trigger's notify target. Admins and above.

methods.name: ListQuestions
methods.description:
ListQuestions returns the open questions addressed to the caller, newest first, or with a
task_id every question of that task (any state) that is visible to the caller. Viewers and
above.

messages.name: AnswerQuestionRequest
messages.description: AnswerQuestionRequest carries exactly one of choice, accept_draft or text.

fields.name: choice
fields.label: singular
fields.description: One of the question's choices, verbatim.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The draft, possibly edited by the person: send the text to use. An empty text means the draft as offered.

messages.name: AnswerQuestionResponse
messages.description: AnswerQuestionResponse holds the resolved question.

messages.name: AskableMember
messages.description: AskableMember is a member who can answer questions.

messages.name: DismissQuestionRequest
messages.description: DismissQuestionRequest names the question.

messages.name: DismissQuestionResponse
messages.description: DismissQuestionResponse holds the resolved question.

messages.name: ListAskableMembersRequest
messages.description: ListAskableMembersRequest names the org.

messages.name: ListAskableMembersResponse
messages.description: ListAskableMembersResponse lists them.

messages.name: ListQuestionsRequest
messages.description: ListQuestionsRequest names the org and optionally a task.

fields.name: task_id
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Empty lists the caller's open questions in the org.

messages.name: ListQuestionsResponse
messages.description: ListQuestionsResponse lists questions.

messages.name: Question
messages.description: Question is one question of an agent to a person.

fields.name: asked_to
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Deprecated: use recipients / waiting_on_user_ids. Set to the first recipient, for older clients.

fields.name: choices
fields.label: repeated
fields.description: Answers offered as buttons; empty means free text only.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Text the agent proposes; empty when none.

fields.name: default_answer
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The safe default, applied when the question is dismissed or expires.

fields.name: can_answer
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Whether the caller can answer or dismiss it now.

fields.name: target
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Who the question was addressed to, as resolved when it was asked.

fields.name: target_label
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The target in plain words: a person's name, "the org's admins", "the org's owners", "the org's members".

fields.name: recipients

fields.name: waiting_since

fields.description:
When it started waiting on the caller (unset when the caller is not a recipient). The inbox ages
items from this; a reminder does not change it.

fields.name: answered_by_name
fields.label: singular
fields.description: The display name of answered_by.

messages.name: Recipient
messages.description: Recipient is one person a question waits on.

enums.name: AnswerKind
enums.description: AnswerKind is how an answer was given.

values.description: One of the question's choices.

values.name: ANSWER_KIND_DRAFT
values.description: The draft, accepted as offered or edited.

values.name: ANSWER_KIND_TEXT
values.description: Free text.

values.name: ANSWER_KIND_DEFAULT
values.description: The safe default, applied by a dismissal or an expiry.

enums.name: QuestionState
enums.description: QuestionState is where a question stands.

values.name: QUESTION_STATE_ASKED
values.description: The agent has asked; its turn has not ended, so nobody sees it yet.

values.name: QUESTION_STATE_OPEN
values.description: Waiting for the person.

values.name: QUESTION_STATE_DISMISSED
values.description: Dismissed by the person; the default was applied.

values.name: QUESTION_STATE_EXPIRED

services.name: RunService
services.description:
RunService reads, cancels and streams runs (ADR 0030). Every request names
the org it acts in; IDs from another org are not found.

methods.name: CancelRun
methods.description: CancelRun cancels a run that has not finished. Members and above.

methods.name: GetRun
methods.description: GetRun returns one run. Viewers and above.

methods.name: WatchRun
methods.description:
WatchRun streams the run's events with seq greater than after_seq, first
the stored ones and then new ones as they are written, each exactly once
and in seq order. To resume after a dropped stream, call again with the
last seq received. The first message is a snapshot of the run; another
snapshot follows whenever its state changes. The stream ends after the
run has finished and every event has been sent. Heartbeat messages keep a quiet
stream open. Viewers and above.

messages.name: CancelRunRequest
messages.description: CancelRunRequest names a run.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Shown on the ticket; defaults to "canceled by <user>".

messages.name: CancelRunResponse
messages.description: CancelRunResponse holds the canceled run.

messages.name: Cost
messages.description:
Cost is model spend recorded by the spend ledger from agentgateway's access
log (plan item L1).

fields.name: requests
fields.label: singular
fields.description: Charged model requests.

fields.name: usd
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
USD as an exact decimal string with at least two fraction digits, for
example "0.0021" or "0.00".

fields.name: priced
fields.label: singular
fields.description: False when some request had no price, so usd undercounts.

fields.name: estimated_requests
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
Requests whose usage the provider did not report and Koinon estimated (included in
requests, tokens and usd). Zero when every request reported its usage.

fields.name: cache_read_tokens
fields.label: singular
fields.description:
input_tokens is the total input, cache reads and writes included. The split by type: the
uncached input is input_tokens - cache_read_tokens - cache_write_tokens. reasoning_tokens is
part of output_tokens where the provider reports it.
